limits: Deployment-scoped bounded log reads only; no account/variable/order operations.
The 22:00–22:15 UTC restart-partial window is excluded from full-window verification.
Detailed traces are selected/bounded by the application's diagnostic sampler; counts/omissions retained.
No causal before/after latency reduction or strategy profitability is inferred.
Only one full post-restart window was available before the collection deadline; repeated full windows are not established.
All retained trace payloads are preserved; selected slow/new-fill cycles are not a representative latency distribution.
Retained-span omission/eviction and quiet work can contribute to unattributed time; unattributed does not mean idle or exclusively scheduler delay.
Status today fields use the source UTC date; the target window is separately specified in UTC and Pacific.
Substring log filters also matched practice statuses with embedded live text; those off-target payloads were discarded and counted.
This bounded collection does not close EXEC-DELAY-001 or certify sustained coverage.
